items.title: Skin Analytics wins £50k West Suffolk contract for AI skin cancer triage
items.summary: West Suffolk NHS Foundation Trust has awarded Skin Analytics Ltd a £50,000 contract to run its DERM AI skin cancer assessment service at West Suffolk Hospital.
